reviewType: AI-assisted discovery review; proposal only; not clinical approval
scope: Current-date topic discovery plus a broader undated search for untracked obesity combinations and muscle-preservation approaches. No live catalogue, monitor source, review date or public wording changes.

candidates.name: EloraTZP (eloralintide plus tirzepatide)
candidates.stage: Completed Phase 2b study; sponsor says Phase 3 co-formulation studies are planned for Q4/by end of 2026, not completed.
candidates.relevance: A separately named amylin-plus-GIP/GLP-1 combination programme; the current catalogue explicitly says it is separate from eloralintide monotherapy but has no separate entry.
candidates.ukAuthorisation: No UK authorisation established by the reviewed sources.
candidates.nhsAccess: No NHS access established by the reviewed sources.
candidates.actualSupply: No lawful UK supply established; investigational programme.
candidates.assessment: The sponsor reports a 48-week Phase 2b study in 367 adults with obesity or overweight and type 2 diabetes. ClinicalTrials.gov independently records NCT06603571 as Phase 2, completed on 14 September 2026 with 367 actual participants. The sponsor's Phase 3 timing is a plan. Combination adverse-event discontinuation was higher than for tirzepatide alone in the sponsor release; no cross-trial ranking should be inferred.

candidates.name: NA-931 plus tirzepatide
candidates.stage: ClinicalTrials.gov Phase 2, not yet recruiting; planned start remains estimated 15 August 2026 despite that date having passed.
candidates.relevance: Previously untracked smaller-developer oral adjunct programme explicitly measuring fat mass, body composition and physical function and describing muscle-mass preservation as a study aim.
candidates.ukAuthorisation: No UK authorisation established by the reviewed sources.
candidates.nhsAccess: No NHS access established by the reviewed sources.
candidates.actualSupply: No lawful UK supply established; registry lists an investigational study outside the UK.
candidates.assessment: The registry is the controlling stage evidence: NCT06732245 is not yet recruiting, with estimated enrolment and completion dates. Developer claims about Phase 3 advancement and preserved muscle mass are not treated as completed trial evidence. Fat-mass, body-composition and physical-function outcomes are planned measurements, not results.

uncertainties: EloraTZP efficacy and safety figures are sponsor-reported; the full conference presentation and a peer-reviewed paper were not independently reviewed in this pass.
ClinicalTrials.gov has no posted results for NCT06603571 in the retrieved record; completed status does not itself validate sponsor-reported outcomes.

The NA-931 developer page and current registry status conflict on development stage. The registry remains not yet recruiting and its estimated start date has passed, so no recruitment or Phase 3 claim is proposed.
The NA-931 registry lists no UK location. Absence from these reviewed sources is not proof of absence from every global regulator or trial register.
No name-specific MHRA or NICE decision was identified in this pass; no negative regulatory claim should be stated without a direct authoritative record.
Industry discovery remains open-ended and incomplete.
